after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), on a 10-year Treasury CFD if the broker quotes one, twelve trades a year, sized by the risk engine, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.calendar: NYSE trading days computed from its rules and its unscheduled closures (scripts/phd1.py); a month is no trade unless IEF has a close on each of its last four
spec.control: every other run of three trading days in the same period, held the same way (reported only)
spec.data: Yahoo daily closes: IEF adjusted for distributions and splits, ^IRX as published (negative and zero yields kept); each file's sha256 in the manifest

gates.costs_x2: mean net per month-end > 0 with the cost per side and the markup doubled
gates.t: t of the mean net return per month-end, 2003..2018, >= the threshold
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total

spec.holdout_rule: 2019-01..2026-09: mean net per month-end > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, and > 0 with the costs doubled
spec.question: does holding the 7-10 year Treasury ETF over each month's last three trading days earn a positive net return at a CFD's costs?
spec.rule: long from the close of the month's fourth-last trading day to the close of its last
